standard-dialogue.npc: Who goes there? This is no place for a human. You need to leave.

standard-dialogue.player: You're starting to scare me man...

standard-dialogue.npc: I am no man! They changed me and cursed me to remain here...

options.text: What do you mean they changed you?

steps.player: What do you mean they changed you?

steps.npc: I was once a free man, powerful and wealthy. I owned several apothecaries across Kourend and sold the tastiest potions in the land.

One of my greatest inventions, it was going so well. I spent days finding the right herbs, I travelled across all of Kourend to find the most exotic weeds. Once I had gathered them all, I put them in a potion and mixed in

steps.text: If the player has not travelled to Great Kourend:
If the player has travelled to Great Kourend:

steps.player: Kourend? Oh yeah, I've been there.

steps.npc: Yes, yes... The potion tasted delicious but it was missing a tiny something so I added Magic roots to the potion. It started to pulsate and glow! I took a sip and I felt like a million gold! A few seconds later my eye sight
began to blur, my brain was throbbing. I fell and hit my head on my worktop, then it all went black.

steps.player: Ouch! But, you still haven't said who changed you?

steps.npc: I woke up screaming in pain. Blue foam streaming out of my mouth, my eye sight worse than before, the only things I could make out were 3 tall figures with green banners - they were of the Arceuus Elders. They

muttered to each other in Archaic Language after trying to get up several times. I lost hope and stared at the sky. I had given up when the tallest of the figures bent over and brought his face right to mine and spoke
very softly 'We can save you, but it will come at a cost'.
Yes of course they saved me but look at the cost! I have horns coming out of my head and I'm still blind and stuck here... forever alone.
I have been charged to stay here to prevent the Monstrosity from escaping. Those gates and the winches that operate them are the only thing that stops it breaking free.

steps.player: What monstrosity? What's behind those gates?

steps.npc: You really do not want to know. Leave this place human.

steps.player: Hey now, I'm no wimp. What's to stop me from just turning the winch to open the gate and going in?

steps.npc: Me. And of course your quick demise at the mercy of Cerberus, guardian of the river of souls.
You are obviously passionate at trying. But only those with great skill at slaying these types of beast may enter.

steps.text: If the player does not have hellhounds or Cerberus herself as a slayer task:

steps.npc: THE VOICES! AAAHHHHH! Leave this place human!

steps.text: If the player has hellhounds or Cerberus herself as a slayer task:

steps.player: I have been charged by the slayer masters to eliminate this type of threat.

steps.npc: Then you may pass... may your soul not end up consumed and forever condemned to the-
THE VOICES! AAAHHHHH! Leave this place human!

during-bear-your-soul.player: Aretha said you might be able to repair the soul bearer for me.

during-bear-your-soul.npc: The soul bearer! You have the soul bearer! The voices speak of it often. It is from this place, yet it is not of this place.
The voices tell me I can. They speak to me!

during-bear-your-soul.text: The Key Master repairs your soul bearer.

during-bear-your-soul.npc: The voices say you must use it wisely.

steps.npc: Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!

treasure-trails-master.text: a torn part of a clue scroll
You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
